news.headline: AAD + HS Foundation issue first joint hidradenitis suppurativa guidelines
news.summary: 37 recommendations published in JAAD Oct 20: biologics (adalimumab, bimekizumab, infliximab, secukinumab) strongly recommended for moderate-to-severe HS; oral retinoids advised against; step therapy called unsupported by evidence. Your HS 'recurrent boils' card went superviral the same day — the news peg is yours.
